info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1 - Employee Management API
info.description: Ordered tests for exact required endpoints, JWT, CRUD, two-user access denial, invalid input and rate limiting. Run the main folders in order. Run the optional rate-limit folder separately.  Safe-to-share export: password and bearer token variables are empty. Configure these in Postman after importing. Vercel production employee IDs are captured from Create Employee A.

item.name: 08 User A lists only own employees

exec: pm.test("A sees employee A only", function () { const ids = pm.response.json().data.map(e => e._id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("employeeAId")); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("employeeBId")); });
